notes:
Summary: Algorift builds an in-IDE copilot for enterprise engineering teams with deep repo awareness. Primary requirement: never send raw private repository content to a public vector DB; embeddings must be stored in-customer VPC or on-prem. Interested in Redwood Dedicated or Private with model pinning per-tenant and low-latency streaming for interactive completion (target <50ms token latency for local dev machines).

From initial discovery: CTO (R. Hayashi) stressed 'we need repo-aware retrieval that respects commit boundaries and branch isolation; PII/secret detection + KMS-backed keying for embeddings.' They run monorepos with ~12M LOC, frequent CI pushes. Use-case priority: fast contextual completions inside IDE, semantic search across codebase, and safe code-action suggestions (lint/auto-fix).

POC asks: 1) sample pipeline for chunking strategy (repo segmentation + chunk size heuristics), 2) options for local vector DB (persistent disk vs managed in VPC), 3) fallback policies when quantized model variants degrade correctness, 4) audit log format and retention controls.

Quote from head of engineering: "We will not accept model variants that introduce hallucinations during refactor suggestions — need eval hooks tied to our unit test suite."

CRM shorthand / recent: demo 2025-02-18 -> good engagement; POC kickoff 2025-02-25 (baseline embedding perf tests running); security review questionnaire sent 2025-03-01. Legal asked for sample contract language for data residency and breach notification SLA. AE notes: engineers care about per-repo token-prefix caching and KV-cache reuse across branches. Costs: medium sensitivity; willing to pay for dedicated capacity if residency and latency SLOs are met.

Stated preferences: open models with token-level tracing, ability to pin model version per-tenant, automated rollbacks for regressions, and Optimize recommendations for batching/caching to reduce unit cost.

Next immediate actions: agree POC success criteria (latency, embeddings recall@10, security checklist items), schedule security deep-dive with infra team (target week of 2025-03-10), deliver draft SOW to procurement by 2025-03-14.
